FN-SLZVG75-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 35
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 35 as introduced would combine the existing vessel registration fees that are based
on length and the existing additional $5 registration fee into a single fee. However, this bill
would not affect the distributions to the State Reservoir Management Grant Fund or the State
Water Safety Fund.
